mapper.insert: insert into crm_customer_refund (refund_no, customer_id, amount, refund_type, receive_name, receive_account, receive_bank, reason, status, creator, create_time) values (#{refundNo}, #{customerId}, #{amount}, #{refundType}, #{receiveName}, #{receiveAccount}, #{receiveBank}, #{reason}, 0, #{creator}, sysdate())
mapper.select: select id, refund_no, customer_id, amount, refund_type, receive_name, receive_account, receive_bank, reason, status, auditor, audit_time, audit_remark, creator, create_time from crm_customer_refund where id = #{id}

select id, refund_no, customer_id, amount, refund_type, receive_name, receive_account, receive_bank, reason, status, auditor, audit_time, audit_remark, creator, create_time from crm_customer_refund where id = #{id} for update
mapper.update: update crm_customer_refund set status = #{status}, auditor = #{auditor}, audit_time = #{auditTime}, audit_remark = #{auditRemark}, update_time = sysdate() where id = #{id} and status = #{expectedStatus}
